page.metaDescription: Your EatPal plan, usage and billing
page.title: Plan and billing
page.subtitle: The plan your account has, what it includes, and how it's billed.

error.body: Couldn't load your plan. Nothing about your billing has changed.
error.offline: You're offline. Your plan will show when you're back online.

free.title: Free plan
free.body: You're not being charged. Your kids, foods and plans are all here.

pastDue.title: Payment failed
pastDue.body: Payment failed. Premium features are paused until your card is updated; your kids, foods and plans are kept.

mismatch.title: Your billing and your plan don't match
mismatch.body: Stripe is billing you for {{billed}}, but your account currently has {{enforced}}. Check the billing portal, or contact support and we will sort it out.

dual.title: You may be billed twice
dual.body: Your {{plan}} plan comes from the App Store, and a card subscription for {{stripePlan}} is also on file with Stripe. Cancel the one you do not want so you are only charged once.

canceling.title: {{plan}} ends on {{date}}
canceling.body: You keep every feature until then, and you won't be charged again.

usage.title: Usage this period
usage.overChildren_one: {{count}} child, your plan allows {{limit}}. Everything you've added stays.
usage.overChildren_other: {{count}} children, your plan allows {{limit}}. Everything you've added stays.
usage.overPantry_one: {{count}} food, your plan allows {{limit}}. Everything you've added stays.
usage.overPantry_other: {{count}} foods, your plan allows {{limit}}. Everything you've added stays.
usage.fullCount: You've used every slot on this plan.

prompt.portal: Change plan in the billing portal

manage.title: Manage your plan
manage.portalHint: Card, invoices and receipts, on Stripe
manage.changePlanHint: Upgrade, downgrade or switch to yearly
manage.reactivateBody: Changed your mind? Keep {{plan}} and nothing else changes.
manage.cancelHint: You keep everything until the end of the period you paid for.
manage.cancelTrialHint: Cancel before the trial ends and you won't be charged.

apple.body: Apple bills this plan, so changes and cancellation happen on your iPhone.
apple.steps: Open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions, then EatPal.

comp.body: There's nothing to pay. Questions about your complimentary plan go to our team.

free.body: More children, unlimited pantry and the AI coach come with a paid plan.

cancel.title: Cancel {{plan}}?
cancel.body: {{plan}} stays active until {{date}}, then you move to Free.
cancel.bodyNoDate: {{plan}} stays active until the end of this billing period, then you move to Free.
cancel.bodyTrial: You won't be charged. Your trial ends {{date}}.
cancel.bodyTrialNoDate: You won't be charged. Your trial ends at the end of this period.
cancel.overChildren_one: You have {{count}} child profile; Free allows {{limit}}. You can still see them all, but not add more.
cancel.overChildren_other: You have {{count}} child profiles; Free allows {{limit}}. You can still see them all, but not add more.
cancel.overPantry_one: You have {{count}} pantry food; Free allows {{limit}}. New foods wait until you are under it.
cancel.overPantry_other: You have {{count}} pantry foods; Free allows {{limit}}. New foods wait until you are under it.
cancel.kept: Your kids, foods and history are kept.
cancel.failed: Couldn't cancel. Your plan hasn't changed; try again.

portal.unavailable: The billing portal isn't available right now. Try again in a minute.
portal.badUrl: We couldn't open the billing portal safely. Nothing was changed.
portal.noCustomer: There's no card billing on this account yet, so there's nothing to manage in the portal.
portal.failed: Couldn't open the billing portal. Nothing about your billing has changed.
